answer: Pay only for work that proves useful downstream. Every output is planted in a shared garden where strangers may harvest it for verified jobs; earnings stay escrowed until two of them reuse the output and their downstream work passes its own checks, like an ember passed between hearths. Fakes nobody reuses earn nothing, and a farmer's copies drain away through the karst, where value, like water in limestone, only surfaces where the ground is real. Reuse leaves a public trail, so each fake must produce genuinely reusable value to earn, and cloning stops paying while honest work compounds.
